# GLS Refrigeration and Air Conditioning

> GLS installs, repairs and maintains refrigeration and air-conditioning systems for homes and businesses in Johannesburg and surrounding areas. It is a registered company (GLS Refrigeration And Air Conditioning (PTY) LTD), operating since 2011, based in Primrose, Germiston, South Africa. Emergency repair is available 24 hours a day, 7 days a week.

## Key facts
- Business: refrigeration and air-conditioning contractor (installation, maintenance, repair, upgrades, consultation)
- Founded: 2011
- Address: 2 Churchill Avenue, Primrose, Germiston, South Africa
- Area served: Johannesburg and surrounding areas
- Phone (calls): 073 654 1480 (+27736541480)
- WhatsApp: +27 61 934 2182 (+27619342182)
- Email: glsrefcon@gmail.com
- Customers: homes, offices, restaurants, supermarkets and other commercial and industrial properties
- Quotes: upfront, no hidden fees. Free site assessments available.

## Services
- [Air-conditioning installation, servicing and repair](https://glsrefrigeration.co.za/air-conditioning.html): split-unit and ducted systems, server room cooling, inverter and energy-efficient upgrades
- [Commercial refrigeration, cold rooms and walk-in freezers](https://glsrefrigeration.co.za/commercial-refrigeration.html): installation, servicing and repair for restaurants, supermarkets and retail
- [Planned maintenance](https://glsrefrigeration.co.za/maintenance.html): inspections, filter cleaning, refrigerant level and wiring checks, performance optimisation
- [All services](https://glsrefrigeration.co.za/services.html)
